queries.exactQuery: Why did brake temp spike in S3 on lap 10?
queries.claim: On the Soft flyer (L10), synthetic ATLAS-like brake_temp peaks at 942°C in the heaviest brake zone (S3), aligned with an engineer duct-check note — overlaid on real OpenF1 brake/speed traces from 2026 COTA FP2.
queries.rationale: Peak sits in the OpenF1-derived heavy-brake window on L10; duct note cites the same distance band.

queries.exactQuery: Why is the front brake cooler than the rear on lap 10?
queries.claim: On the Soft flyer, synthetic front-left brake temp peaks at 688°C in the same S3 heavy where rear brake_temp hits 942°C. Front stays under the public ATLAS example warning of 700°C — the split fits a rear duct, not a whole-axle cooling loss.
queries.rationale: Both overlays share the OpenF1 heavy-brake window. Front uses the documented Brakes.FrontLeft.Temperature warning; rear is the 942°C duct flag.

queries.exactQuery: Was the S3 stop a late stab or a trail?
queries.claim: Synthetic brake_pressure peaks at 71.7 bar at 3689 m while speed is still 213 km/h, then falls to 37.5 bar by the release at 97 km/h. That is a trail shaped from the OpenF1 brake (held at 100) times speed — not a late stab.
queries.rationale: OpenF1 brake is only 0/100. The overlay rises at the start of the application and decays as speed bleeds.

queries.exactQuery: Where did DRS open on the Soft flyer?
queries.claim: It didn't. OpenF1 drs is 0 on every sample in this FP2 pack. On LEC's fastest stretch (2870–3660 m) the car still reaches 332 km/h with DRS off.
queries.rationale: The drs channel is flat zero for the whole field pack. The cite locks the Soft-flyer speed peak so the off state sits on the straight where an opening would show.

queries.exactQuery: Which gear did he hold on the longest straight?
queries.claim: OpenF1 n_gear holds 8th for 726 m on the Soft flyer, from 2986 m to 3712 m — through the end of S2 and into the S3 brake.
queries.rationale: Longest constant gear at or above 6th on L10. The window crosses the S2/S3 boundary.

queries.exactQuery: Did coolant soak after the heavy brake?
queries.claim: No soak step. Synthetic coolant_temp drifts from 94.1°C at the start of the lap to 98.2°C at the line. Through the S3 heavy it only moves 96.6→96.8°C, then 96.8→98.2°C after — a steady climb, not a post-brake spike.
queries.rationale: Low-rate Engine.Temperature-style overlay. The heavy window does not add a step above the lap drift.

queries.exactQuery: How hot was the Soft tyre through S2?
queries.claim: Synthetic tyre_surf_fl peaks at 128°C through S2 on the Soft flyer vs 105°C on the Hard push — hotter Soft surface overlay on the same OpenF1 speed/throttle window.
queries.rationale: S2 peak comparison Soft L10 vs Hard L7 on the synthetic tyre surface channel.

queries.exactQuery: Where is the biggest steering input on lap 10?
queries.claim: Synthetic steering peaks at 26° near 583 m on the Soft flyer, derived from OpenF1 location curvature — not a SECU steer sensor.
queries.rationale: Absolute peak on the steering overlay away from the start/finish join.

queries.exactQuery: What longitudinal g did the S3 heavy produce?
queries.claim: Synthetic g_long troughs at −1.97 g in the S3 heavy (derived from OpenF1 speed), aligned with the brake-pressure trail window.
queries.rationale: Speed-derived long-g in the same heavy as the duct thermal story.

queries.exactQuery: Where was fuel flow highest on the Soft flyer?
queries.claim: Synthetic fuel_flow (ATLAS FuelFlow-style) peaks at 110 kg/h through S2 on throttle — shaped from OpenF1 throttle × rpm, not a team fuel meter.
queries.rationale: S2 window on Soft flyer where throttle demand is sustained.

queries.exactQuery: What was the Soft speed trap vs Hard?
queries.claim: OpenF1 speed trap: Soft flyer st_speed 319 km/h vs Hard 314 km/h (Δ +5). Intermediate traps on Soft: I1 221 / I2 183 km/h.
queries.rationale: Lap-level OpenF1 trap fields already on the Soft and Hard pack laps.

queries.exactQuery: Did the track cool during FP2?
queries.claim: Yes. OpenF1 weather series shows track temperature falling 42.4→39.1°C over FP2 (Δ −3.3°C). Air stays ~29.7–29.3°C. Soft flyer ran mid-session.

queries.exactQuery: When did Leclerc fit Softs?
queries.claim: OpenF1 stint map puts LEC Soft stint 2 on laps 9–11. He pitted on lap 9 (lane 311.8 s) ahead of that Soft stint — the L10 flyer sits inside it.

queries.exactQuery: Any team radio for Leclerc in FP2?
queries.claim: OpenF1 published 12 team-radio clips for this FP2; 0 are for car 16 (LEC). No LEC audio in the public subset.
queries.rationale: OpenF1 /team_radio for session 11390 — honest empty for LEC.

queries.exactQuery: Where did Soft gain vs the Hard push?
queries.claim: L10 Soft is ~1.2 s quicker than L7 Hard, with a large share of the advantage through S2 on the OpenF1 sector times.
queries.rationale: Real OpenF1 lap/sector times for LEC FP2; speed/rpm overlays vs L7 localize the Soft gain.

queries.exactQuery: Any notes on cooling in this stint?
queries.claim: Session notes call for a rear duct check if Soft push-lap brake_temp peaks exceed ~850°C in the heavy zone.
queries.rationale: Retrieved from engineer notes tagged cooling / brakes (synthetic ATLAS overlay guidance).

queries.exactQuery: What happened to oil pressure in the S3 heavy?
queries.claim: Synthetic oil_pressure softens under the L10 S3 heavy — still above abort; correlate with brake energy on the OpenF1 brake channel, not a pump fault.
queries.rationale: Low-rate Engine.OilPressure-style overlay + duct/cooling note in the same window.

queries.exactQuery: Any track limits issues for Leclerc?
queries.claim: Race control deleted an earlier LEC lap time for track limits at Turn 19 — the RE note flags keeping the car inside at stadium exit.
queries.rationale: Grounded in OpenF1 race_control messages from 2026 COTA FP2 plus the session note.

queries.exactQuery: Which failure mode matches the brake spike?
queries.claim: Corpus failure mode “Rear brake duct restriction” matches a rear peak of 942°C while front-left stays at 688°C in the same heavy, plus the duct note. Brake pressure trails with speed, so the spike is not a late stab.
queries.rationale: Failure-mode hints now include brake_temp_fl and brake_pressure beside brake_temp, brake, and speed.
